name: Exec Cluster E03: Unit + Notional Sizing Modes
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E03: Unit + Notional Sizing Modes
# Tests: position_size(type=SizeType.unit) and position_size(type=SizeType.notional)
# Using unit mode here (100 shares fixed)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bull, exit=not is_bull)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=100)

atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
